note: Field maps are maps whose name contains '_fild'. Roles follow strategy section 8.11: field_boss for boss_monster lines, rare for 5 or fewer with a respawn of 30 minutes or more, plant for immobile AI type 06, common for 10 or more with a respawn of 60 seconds or less, and uncommon otherwise. Biomes come from map name prefixes; maps listed in unassigned_biome_maps need a manual biome.
